fix(release): verify final branch reference identity

Validate the full live branch reference before tags and package pushes.

keeping local qualification offline and preserving exact CI run and attempt
binding.

Retain the newer final prepare hook, publisher and prerelease controls,
and name the shell fixture argument for static analysis.

commit.message:
fix(release): bind final source and CI checks

Verify emitted CI proof and stop stale source tags and uploads.
Exercise real lifecycle callers and retain safe API diagnostics.

fix(release): verify final branch reference identity

Recheck complete live refs and production executed validation before tags
or package pushes.

Keep local executed qualification offline and preserve recorded CI run
and attempt checks.

test(release): name live source fixture argument

Address shell:S7679 by binding the helper argument locally before jq.

Keep the full-reference fixtures and all 28 release-source cases unchanged.

@@ -9,24 +9,38 @@ cat > "$test_dir/gh" <<'EOF'
 set -euo pipefail
 if [ "$1" != api ]; then exit 90; fi
 case "$2" in
-  */git/ref/heads/*) printf '%s\n' "$MOCK_LIVE_SHA" ;;

+  repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/git/ref/heads/main|repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/git/ref/heads/prerelease)
+    [ "$#" = 2 ] || exit 92

+    printf '%s\n' "$MOCK_LIVE_REF" ;;
+  repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/actions/runs/123)
+    [ "$#" = 2 ] || exit 92
+    printf '%s\n' "$MOCK_RUN" ;;
+  "repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=${DISPATCH_SHA}&event=push&status=completed&per_page=100")

   *) exit 91 ;;
 esac
 EOF
 chmod +x "$test_dir/gh"
 export PATH="$test_dir:$PATH"
 export REPOSITORY=Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds
 export DISPATCH_SHA=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
-export MOCK_LIVE_SHA="$DISPATCH_SHA"

-

+}

@@ -45,6 +59,23 @@ expect_fail() {

 export MOCK_RUNS

 export DISPATCH_REF MOCK_RUNS
+set_live_ref "$DISPATCH_SHA"

 export MOCK_RUNS

@@ -15,8 +15,13 @@ if [[ ! "$DISPATCH_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
 fi
 
 branch="${DISPATCH_REF#refs/heads/}"
-live_sha="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${branch}" --jq '.object.sha')"
-if [[ ! "$live_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || [ "$DISPATCH_SHA" != "$live_sha" ]; then
+live_ref="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${branch}")"
+if ! jq -e --arg repository "$REPOSITORY" --arg ref "$DISPATCH_REF" --arg sha "$DISPATCH_SHA" '
+  type == "object" and .ref == $ref

+' <<< "$live_ref" >/dev/null; then
   echo "Builds Release source is not the exact current ${branch} tip." >&2

 fi

response.body:
GitHub records an external force-push at18:41UTC that moved main from merged PR162 commitc58c3cb78de3cb6cc10ff2924c56e7f70f359997 back to ancestor5fa2b97c8b22047c2c33e2c9f7017fd5d604c9ef. The normal release correctly refused that stale source after qualification. A normal fast-forward restored the reviewed commit; GitHub reported an automatic account-level bypass for PR/Codacy rules on that restoration.

Integrate the original reviewed branch through the protected PR path before publication. Its source tree is e94444c7163d835012542a4a5231578bb36e09c5, identical to restored main. The implementation and helper naming were reviewed in PR162 and passed its complete CI, plus fresh main CI42082834472. This PR retains the original commits and requires normal checks for the branch integration. It adds no implementation change and grants no publication or native acceptance from the failed run. The first release failure and force-push activity remain retained.
